mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while chlorpromazine may increase isoniazid hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor for chlorpromazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, orthostasis); consider dose reduction of chlorpromazine or alternative antipsychotic; monitor liver function tests.
